name: EPIC 205906794

text.card: A red giant 3,625 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.86 solar masses and 16.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,431 K at its surface.
